note: What the HUD says about reads and about the guided first match (docs/ui/hud-spec.md sections 18 and 19). finisher_counter: the stance that answers each finisher kind (Game Design, spec-wounds.md section 1: GUARD a launch, DODGE a melee, PRESS a beam with 40 Charge); the telegraph chip shows it only while prompts are on. beat_ids: the tutorial's nine beats in order (the dots under a hint). hints: Narrative's lines (docs/narrative/tutorial-hints.md), keyed beat.variant; a tutorial_hint event names its key and the HUD looks the words up here. Lines are plain text, at most about ten words.

hints.b1.hint: Fly. The world wraps: keep going and you come back round.
hints.b1.alt0: Head for your rival, or keep going and watch the world wrap.
hints.b1.nudge: Try flying the other way. It's the same planet.
hints.b2.hint: You are the fighter. Pick a stance and your blows play out to match.
hints.b2.alt0: Change stance and watch your fighter change.
hints.b2.alt1: Try a different stance. Your blows follow it.
hints.b2.nudge: Pick another stance. Your blows will change with it.
hints.b3.alt0: A guarding rival breaks under heavy blows.
hints.b3.nudge: Set your attack to heavy while they guard.
hints.b4.hint: Watch the body: that's how you read damage.
hints.b4.alt0: No health bar. Look at their arms, legs and head.
hints.b4.alt1: Where is the rival hurt? Look.
hints.b4.nudge: Look at the rival. Where are they worn?
hints.b4.done: Now you can read a wound.
hints.b5.alt0: A heavy is winding up. DODGE, or GUARD and wait.
hints.b5.alt1: See the wind-up? Answer it with a stance.
hints.b5.nudge: When they wind up big, choose DODGE or GUARD.
hints.b5.done: You read it and answered it. That's the game.
hints.b6.alt0: Hold Charge until it's full enough, then set your signature.
hints.b6.nudge: Charge up. Your signature needs a full 45.
hints.b7.hint: You're ready. Transform when you choose.
hints.b7.alt0: The change is ready. Take it whenever you like.
hints.b7.nudge: Your transformation is ready. Nobody will stop you.
hints.b7.done: Nobody interrupts a transformation. Take your time.
hints.b8.hint: They're going for the finish. Brace, slip or meet it.
hints.b8.alt0: A finisher is coming. Pick the stance that answers it.
hints.b8.alt1: Their finish has a kind. Match it.
hints.b8.nudge: Choose a stance to match their finisher.
hints.b8.done: You held. The fight is still yours.
hints.b9.hint: From here, the fight is yours.
hints.b9.alt0: You have the reads. Go and win.
hints.b9.alt1: That's everything. It's your fight now.
